paper title: Learn-As-You-Fly: A Distributed Algorithm for Joint 3D Placement and User Association in Multi-UAVs Networks
authors: H. El Hammouti; M. Benjillali; B. Shihada; M.-S. Alouini
mathematical objective: Distributed placement/user association for throughput and coverage
assumptions: Neighborhood-limited updates and communication model applicability
metrics: coverage, throughput proxy, convergence, gate margin
known deviations from the paper: Reference decomposition; not an exact reproduction of the original distributed solver

paper title: Joint Trajectory and Communication Design for Multi-UAV Enabled Wireless Networks
authors: Q. Wu; Y. Zeng; R. Zhang
research question: Joint scheduling, association, trajectory and power control
mathematical objective: Max-min service objective with joint trajectory/communication decisions
assumptions: Finite planning horizon and model-specific convex approximations
known deviations from the paper: Deterministic heuristic reference; not the paper's complete SCA implementation

paper title: Energy Minimization for Wireless Communication with Rotary-Wing UAV
authors: Y. Zeng; J. Xu; R. Zhang
mathematical objective: Minimize propulsion and communication energy under service constraints
assumptions: Rotary-wing coefficients require vehicle calibration
known deviations from the paper: Reference planner using NETLAB energy model, not a complete trajectory optimizer

paper title: Graph-Theoretic Connectivity Control of Mobile Robot Networks
authors: M. M. Zavlanos; M. B. Egerstedt; G. J. Pappas
mathematical objective: Maintain weighted graph connectivity using Laplacian structure
assumptions: Graph weights depend on active communication model
validation evidence: graph metric reference tests and dry-run
known deviations from the paper: Uses a documented connectivity surrogate with NETLAB link weights

paper title: Coverage Control for Mobile Sensing Networks
authors: J. Cortes; S. Martinez; T. Karatas; F. Bullo
mathematical objective: Weighted Voronoi/Lloyd coverage objective
assumptions: Coverage density and region geometry must be specified
known deviations from the paper: Adds communication and energy penalties not present in the original formulation

paper title: Flocking for Multi-Agent Dynamic Systems: Algorithms and Theory
authors: R. Olfati-Saber
mathematical objective: Cohesion, separation, velocity consensus and navigation
assumptions: First-order reference and neighbor graph assumptions
known deviations from the paper: Communication-feasibility weighting and hard shield are NETLAB extensions

paper title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
authors: A. D. Ames; X. Xu; J. W. Grizzle; P. Tabuada
mathematical objective: Minimally modify control subject to barrier constraints
assumptions: Guarantees depend on model, differentiability and solver feasibility
known deviations from the paper: Deterministic projection fallback when a QP backend is unavailable

paper title: Integrating Online Learning and Connectivity Maintenance for Communication-Aware Multi-Robot Coordination
authors: Yang et al.
research question: Learn communication quality online while preserving connectivity
mathematical objective: Uncertainty-aware link-quality surrogate with connectivity constraint
assumptions: Requires calibrated observations and uncertainty model
known deviations from the paper: Kernel surrogate reference; full Gaussian-process calibration is optional

paper title: PettingZoo: Gym for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: J. K. Terry et al.
mathematical objective: Parallel simultaneous-action environment
assumptions: Training framework remains external; authoritative state remains NETLAB
metrics: reward decomposition, shield acceptance, service metrics
known deviations from the paper: PettingZoo-compatible interface without mandatory library dependency

paper title: FlyNetSim: An Open Source Synchronized UAV Network Simulator based on ns-3 and ArduPilot
authors: S. Baidya; Z. Shaikh; M. Levorato
mathematical objective: Publish/subscribe coupling and explicit temporal synchronization
assumptions: External protocol simulator required
known deviations from the paper: Classified as external adapter, not bundled ns-3 runtime

paper title: UavNetSim-v1: A Python-based Simulation Platform for UAV Communication Networks
authors: Zhou et al.
mathematical objective: Plugin registries for mobility, energy, MAC and routing
assumptions: Independent simulator architecture
known deviations from the paper: Used as an extensibility benchmark, not embedded

paper title: Ns3 meets Sionna: Using Realistic Channels in Network Simulation
authors: A. Zubow; Y. Pilz; S. Rosler; F. Dressler
mathematical objective: Channel caching aligned with mobility/coherence time
assumptions: Requires ns-3 and Sionna integration
metrics: cache hit, channel age, adapter latency
known deviations from the paper: No bundled ns-3 runtime

paper title: Toward Digital Network Twins: Integrating Sionna RT in ns-3 for 6G Multi-RAT Networks Simulations
authors: Pegurri et al.
research question: Digital network twin with ray-traced channels and protocol simulation
mathematical objective: Synchronize geometry-aware channel and network layers
assumptions: External ns-3/Sionna RT stack required
known deviations from the paper: Classified as external adapter

paper title: AirTwinX: A High-Fidelity Digital Twin for Advanced Air Mobility with Ray Tracing
authors: A. Dey et al.
research question: Context-aware aerial digital twin using Isaac and ray tracing
mathematical objective: Geometry-aware link quality informs control
assumptions: System-specific implementation and calibration
known deviations from the paper: NETLAB adds feasibility-gated packet/runtime semantics

paper title: RotorPy: A Python-based Multirotor Simulator with Aerodynamics for Education and Research
authors: F. Folk et al.
research question: Accessible multirotor dynamics with aerodynamics, wind and sensors
mathematical objective: 6-DoF dynamics, motor/drag/sensor abstractions
assumptions: Vehicle parameters require calibration
known deviations from the paper: Used as a validation/design reference; Isaac remains embodied executor

paper title: Aerial Gym Simulator: A Framework for Highly Parallelized Simulation of Aerial Robots
authors: P. Kulkarni; M. Rehberg; K. Alexis
mathematical objective: Large-scale GPU-parallel data generation
assumptions: Different simulator/runtime architecture
known deviations from the paper: Not embedded in mandatory runtime

paper title: A Mobility-Resilient Spectrum Sharing Framework for Operating Wireless UAVs in the 6 GHz Band
authors: V. Hu et al.
research question: Joint mobility, association and power under incumbent protection
mathematical objective: Spectrum-sharing objective and interference constraints
assumptions: Regulatory assumptions and channel model must match scenario
known deviations from the paper: Abstract coexistence model, not regulatory certification

paper title: Swarm UAV Networking with Collaborative Beamforming and Automated ESN Learning in the Presence of Unknown Blockages
authors: Moorthy et al.
mathematical objective: Joint array/learning-assisted beam control
assumptions: Coherent phase behavior is abstract unless PHY adapter active
known deviations from the paper: Abstract array baseline at F1/F2

paper title: Age of Information: A New Concept, Metric, and Tool
authors: A. Kosta; N. Pappas; V. Angelakis
mathematical objective: Schedule using generation time and latest delivered update
assumptions: Requires timestamped generated/delivered packets
known deviations from the paper: Discrete scheduling abstraction

paper title: NASA-STD-7009B and NASA-HDBK-7009B
authors: NASA
research question: Credible development and use of models and simulations
mathematical objective: Intended use, acceptance criteria, V&V, uncertainty, sensitivity, risk and evidence
assumptions: Project defines acceptance authority; no certification claim
known deviations from the paper: Applied as discipline, not claimed certification
